steps.title: Prepare Work Environment
steps.instruction: Prepare the work bench in a clean environment using ethanol, RNAseZAP, DNA-OFF, or similar reagents.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis master-mix, ensuring PEG is fully solubilized by pipetting up and down or vortexing water and PEG together before adding other reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL lysis buffer to each well of a 96/384 well plate.
Quickly centrifuge the plate to collect the buffer before storage.

steps.title: Sort Single Cells
steps.instruction: Sort single cells into 3 µL of lysis buffer in either 96 or 384 wells.

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate with appropriate seals (-80 °C to >100 °C).
Centrifuge the sorted plate immediately.
Transfer the plate to a -80 °C freezer or dry-ice.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Remove the sorted cell plate from the -80 °C freezer and incubate in a thermocycler with a heated lid.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Hold at 4 °C (keep storage seal on unless damaged).

steps.title: Prepare 22% PEG Clean-up Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the 22% PEG Clean-up Beads by combining the following reagents in a 50 mL falcon tube: 11 g PEG 8000, 10 mL 5M NaCl, 500 μL 1M Tris-HCL (pH 8.0), 100 μL 0.5M EDTA, 50 μL 10% IGEPAL solution, and 250 μL 10% Sodium Azide.

substeps.instruction: Add UltraPure Water up to 49 mL, but only after PEG is completely solubilized.
Incubate at 40 °C and vortex regularly until PEG is completely dissolved.
Carefully resuspend Sera-Mag Speed Beads stock.
Pipette 1000 µL of bead suspension into a 1.5 mL tube, place on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Wash beads by adding 1000 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA (TE), placing on magnet, and removing supernatant; repeat this wash once more.
Add 900 µL TE (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA), resuspend beads, and add the mixture to the PEG solution and mix well.

steps.title: Purify cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the preamplified cDNA using the prepared 22% PEG beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 22% PEG beads to the sample at a 0.6:1 ratio and mix by gently pipetting up and down.
Incubate at room temperature for 8 minutes.
Place on a magnet for approximately 5 minutes until beads settle.
Discard supernatant and wash once with 80% Ethanol (20 µL for 384-well plates or 100 µL for 96-well plates).
Remove ethanol and air dry beads for 2 to 5 minutes.
Elute cDNA in 12 µL UltraPure Water, resuspend beads, and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the cDNA concentration using QuantiFluor® dsDNA Dye.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1X TE buffer (dilute 20X TE or use 10mM Tris-HCl, 0.1mM EDTA, pH 8).
Dilute QuantiFluor® dsDNA Dye 1:400 in 1X TE buffer and mix.
Prepare dsDNA standards per manufacturer's protocol.
Dispense 49 µL (384-well) or 99 µL (96-well) of dye mix into black, flat-bottom plates.
Add standards to a separate plate.
Add 1 µL of cDNA to each well and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Measure fluorescence using a plate reader (504nM Excitation / 531nM Emission).
Calculate cDNA concentration and determine the volume of water needed to dilute 1 µL cDNA to 100 pg/uL.

steps.title: Normalize cDNA
steps.instruction: Normalize the cDNA samples to a uniform concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a normalization plate by adding the calculated water volumes to each well.
Add 1 µL of preamplified cDNA to each well.

steps.title: Verify Library Quality
steps.instruction: Check the cDNA preamplification library content and quality using an Agilent Bioanalyzer with High Sensitivity DNA Analysis chips.

steps.title: Final Library Clean-up
steps.instruction: Perform a final clean-up of the pooled tagmented cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Pool all tagmented cDNA sample wells into a 1.5mL or 5mL eppendorf tube.
Add 22% PEG beads to the final volume at a 0.6:1 ratio, mix gently, and incubate for 8 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet for approximately 5 minutes until beads settle.
Discard supernatant and wash twice with ≥ 1000 µL freshly prepared 80% Ethanol.
Remove ethanol and air dry beads for at least 5 minutes.
Elute cDNA in 40 µL UltraPure Water, resuspend beads, and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final Library Inspection
steps.instruction: Inspect the final library quality and quantify the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Run the library on an Agilent Bioanalyzer (High Sensitivity DNA) to check quality and median base-pair length.
Quantify the library using a Qubit fluorometer or similar device.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the library on an Illumina compatible sequencer (Single-end or Paired-end).

substeps.instruction: Ensure the expected median base-pair length is around or above 1kb.
If using NovaSeq/HiSeq, consider increasing loading concentration for proper cluster density.

steps.title: Convert BCL to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Convert binary base-call files (BCL) to fastq using bcl2fastq v2.20.

substeps.instruction: Adjust the base mask to match the sequencing layout and barcode read length.
Remove the --no-lane-splitting option if cell barcodes were reused across different lanes.
Use options --loading-threads, --processing-threads, and --writing-threads to restrict core usage.
Example command for 2x150bp dual-index: bcl2fastq --use-bases-mask Y150N,I8,I8,Y150N --no-lane-splitting --create-fastq-for-index-reads -R [runfolder] -o [output folder].

steps.title: Process Data with zUMIs
steps.instruction: Process the fastq files using the zUMIs pipeline (recommended v2.5.6) to handle UMI and internal reads.

substeps.instruction: Create a YAML configuration file specifying project name, sequence files (cDNA, UMI, and BC definitions), reference STAR index, GTF file, and filter cutoffs.
Invoke the pipeline using the command: zUMIs-master.sh -y Smartseq3.yaml
